summary: XRD analysis of CsPbBr3 nanocrystals synthesized with varying oleic acid (OlA) to oleylamine (Oleym) ratios reveals that pure CsPbBr3 phase is present for OlA:Oleym ratios up to 0.7:0.3, while higher OlA content (0.8:0.2 and 0.9:0.1) leads to the appearance of additional CsPb2Br5 peaks, indicating phase impurity or secondary phase formation.
experimental_variables: OlA:Oleym ratio (oleic acid to oleylamine concentration)

key_findings.finding: For OlA:Oleym ratios from 0.1:0.9 to 0.7:0.3, XRD patterns show only CsPbBr3 peaks at consistent positions.
For OlA:Oleym ratios of 0.8:0.2 and 0.9:0.1, additional peaks corresponding to CsPb2Br5 are observed alongside CsPbBr3.

scientific_interpretation.claim: Increasing the proportion of oleic acid relative to oleylamine beyond a threshold (≥0.8:0.2) induces the formation of a secondary CsPb2Br5 phase in addition to CsPbBr3.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: The appearance of additional peaks assigned to CsPb2Br5 only at higher OlA:Oleym ratios (0.8:0.2 and 0.9:0.1) suggests a compositional threshold for phase purity.

citations.evidence: Additional peaks of CsPb2Br5 appear for OlA:Oleym ratios 0.8:0.2 and 0.9:0.1
The * in the ratios of OlA:Oleym :: 0.8:0.2 and OlA:Oleym :: 0.9:0.1 signifies the presence of additional peaks of CsPb 2 Br 5

scientific_interpretation.claim: The CsPbBr3 phase is structurally stable across a wide range of OlA:Oleym ratios (0.1:0.9 to 0.7:0.3), as indicated by identical peak positions and narrow peak widths.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: All samples with OlA:Oleym ≤ 0.7:0.3 show the same set of peak positions and narrow peak widths, indicating no detectable structural change or phase impurity.

limitations.claim: No quantitative information on crystallite size or microstrain is available due to missing FWHM data.
Relative phase fractions of CsPbBr3 and CsPb2Br5 cannot be determined from the provided data.
Intensity trends and possible changes in crystallinity or preferred orientation are not discussed or quantified.

citations.evidence: No intensity or crystallinity data provided

limitations.claim: Lattice parameters are not reported, so subtle structural distortions or compositional changes within the CsPbBr3 phase cannot be assessed.
